King Conan is an upcoming American sword-and-sorcery film written and directed by Christopher McQuarrie. It serves as the sequel to Conan the Destroyer (1984), with Arnold Schwarzenegger reprising his role as the titular character.
Cast
* Arnold Schwarzenegger as Conan the Barbarian
Production
In March 2026, during the Arnold Sports Festival, Arnold Schwarzenegger revealed that a sequel to Conan the Destroyer (1984) was in development at 20th Century Studios, with Christopher McQuarrie set to write and direct.
